entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Applicant :- Laxmi Kant Agarwal And 3 Others
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Gyan Prakash Shrivastava,Yogesh Kumar Sinha

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Sushil Shukla
Hon'ble Vinod Diwakar,J.
1.
Second supplementary affidavit filed today is taken on record.

2. Heard learned counsel for the applicants, learned A.G.A. for the State-respondent, and perused the entire record.
3.

The instant application has been preferred with the prayer to quash the charge sheet dated 29.08.2015 and cognizance order dated 01.10.2015 as well as entire proceedings of Case No. 4244 of 2015, tilted as State vs. Laxmi Kant and others, arising out of Case Crime No. 442 of 2015, under Section 436, 379, 120B, 420, 406 IPC, P.S. Akbarpur, District Kanpur Dehat, pending in the court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kanpur Dehat, on the basis of the compromise.

entities.text: State vs. Laxmi Kant and others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
4. Learned counsel for the applicants submits that since the parties have settled their dispute amicably vide compromise deed dated 18.05.2016 and opposite party no.2 does not want to proceed Laxmi Kant Agarwal And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/105238913/
1

entities.text: Laxmi Kant Agarwal And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: with trial, therefore, no fruitful purpose would be served by keeping the matter pending.
5. Learned counsel for opposite party no. 2 does not dispute the fact of compromise entered between the parties, and said he has no objection if the proceedings are put to rest.

6. Since the dispute between the parties has been amicably settled, no fruitful purpose would be served by permitting to continue the criminal case pending before the trial court and it would simply a waste of judicial time as chances of conviction are very bleak.

7. In such circumstances, the charge sheet dated 29.08.2015 and cognizance order dated 01.10.2015 as well as entire proceedings of Case No. 4244 of 2015, tilted as State vs. Laxmi Kant and others,
arising out of Case Crime No. 442 of 2015, under Section 436, 379, 120B, 420, 406 IPC, P.S.
Akbarpur, District Kanpur Dehat, pending in the court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kanpur Dehat,
against the applicants, are hereby quashed.

entities.text: State vs. Laxmi Kant and others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 8. The instant petition stands allowed, accordingly.
